prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1396; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of right shoulder pain and limited range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of thirteen visits, care followed a conventional progression, beginning with immobilization, anti-inflammatory medication, and graded physical therapy, and frequency of visits was reduced as symptoms improved. Examination documented reduced active abziction and tenderness over the rotator cuff insertion, which support the diagnosis, while several other provocative and neurovascular tests returned normal results. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Treatment charges were billed once per service, with no duplicated or repeated entries. At discharge from active care, the patient had regained most functional motion and reported pain at a low level, with a home exercise program continued and follow-up available as needed.
